newsitem.title: RUSSIA: First Russian Eurobond to be at end November.
newsitem.headline: First Russian Eurobond to be at end November.

text.p: Russia will issue its debut Eurobond at the end of November after the road-show which starts November 11, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.
"We are going to do it in November," Vladimir Dmitriyev, deputy head of the foreign credits department, told Reuters.
He was commenting on rumours on Russian financial markets that the Eurobond issue could be postponed.
Russia has not yet decided how much money it would raise in the first issue, he said.
"We shall start the road-show, as we had planned, on November 11, and we shall define the volume of the issue," Dmitriyev said.
"We are planning presentations in London, New York and other big U.S. cities and in Frankfurt. The road-show will last for two weeks."
Bankers said the volume of the first Eurobond issue could be between $300-$500 million.
Last month Russia received better-than-expected high speculative ratings for the issue from leading rating agencies.
